# The arm64 leak-matrix pins: cell, native-arm64 verdict, self-host-arm64
# verdict, note. Same loader rules as selfhost-leak-matrix.txt (the x86 file);
# regenerate with FERN_LEAK_MATRIX_DUMP=1 on TestSelfHostLeakMatrixIRArm64.
#
# Six rows differ from the x86 file on the NATIVE side only: native-x86 reads
# clean because SSO keeps these <=7-byte strings inline (allocs=0), while
# native-arm64 heap-allocates them (no SSO on its concat path) and its own
# reclaim then leaks the shape - measured 200/100, 16 B/round on the rebind
# probe. A native-arm64 backend gap surfaced by the cross-ISA census; the
# self-host columns agree with the x86 file on every cell. Filed as #7446.
